gameID.description: The unique ID linking this set to its base game context (e.g., 'core').

setID.description: The exact lowercase identifier code for this collection directory (e.g., 'first').

name.description: The clean display name of this set.

icon.description: The relative file path to the texture graphic representing this set's expansion logo.

frame.description: The standard border asset texture path used as the default frame fallback for all cards assigned to this set.

cards.description: A list of string IDs indicating all card definition files assigned to this collection.

packs.description: A list of string IDs indicating booster pack variations associated with this set.
